title: Basic katakana: N and H rows — write in kana
description: Use Latin-letter syllable cues to recall and type the matching katakana signs. Kana answers only; no sign is displayed in the question.

exercises.prompt: From the Latin-letter spelling cue below, recall and type its katakana sign (not romaji).

stimulus.translation: Latin-letter cue for the basic katakana na sign.

text.gloss: Katakana sign for the basic na reading.

exercises.explanation: The katakana spelling for written na is ナ. Katakana sign for the basic na reading. Only the authored katakana spelling is accepted; hiragana is not an alias.
